reference_labels: chronogeographic proxies from source Group label only; not proven pure ancestry

selection.dates: valid positive cal.BP mean within95CI; source SupplementaryData7; no negative TableI/II BP copied
selection.ranking: coverage descending, averageGP descending, exact subjectID ascending

region.support: retained center100bp bins clipped to actual inferred coverage; exact query-bp; no tail extrapolation
region.map: real GRCh37 chromosome22 recombination map must be separately obtained/versioned/hashed; no fabricated constant map

observation_QC.reference_panel_MAF: min(RAF,1-RAF)>=0.05, finite NumberA scalar; never target AF
observation_QC.genotype: all20 selected subjects callable diploid, GP triplet finite[0,1], rounded sum within0.002, maxGP>=0.8; sites failing any selected subject excluded identically for all HS runs
observation_QC.HS: all20 have valid 0<=HS<2**(2*NMAIN), NMAIN15, decoded fixed iteration index per individual across entire ligated region
observation_QC.GT_baseline: verify actual phased separators in entire admitted region; preserve source GT
observation_QC.ancestral_state: pan_troglodytes must encode one A/C/G/T equal to REF or ALT; exclude missing/conflicting/third allele; do not call REF ancestral
observation_QC.failure: fail cohort/region admission; do not tune thresholds, duplicate references, fabricate phase, or use AP to recover sites

primary_endpoint.name: median_query_posterior_observation_Jensen_Shannon_sensitivity_nats
primary_endpoint.definition: For each query subject, average its two haplotype C4 probability vectors to a diploid mean. For each HSdraw0..7 compare with frozen phased-GT run by Jensen-Shannon divergence using natural logs and0log0=0. Integrate over identical represented100bp bins, divide by exact scored diploid-query bp, average over8 draws, then take median across12 subjects.
primary_endpoint.falsifiable_claim: a fixed method/checkpoint is observation-stable on this frozen cohort/region if median<=0.05nats; otherwise claim fails
primary_endpoint.HS_changes: both genotype and phase posterior uncertainty; never labelled pure phase error
primary_endpoint.checkpoint_selection: simulation-trained checkpoint identities frozen before real-data extraction; no real-data tuning/selection

secondary_descriptive: all12 per-subject sensitivities and query-bp coverage
raw GT vs HS heterozygosity/dosage changes from admitted observations
masked SNP/call counts and source global coverage strata
optional GP>=0.9 condition only under a separately declared common-support report; no primary redefinition
ARGformer_adaptation: if within-ARG unsupervised adaptation is used, separately disclose/freeze steps/objective/seed; use no proxy/query ancestry targets or AP and report separately from direct simulation-trained inference
AP_policy: remove FORMAT/AP and header definitions before any genotype/tree/model artifact; no AP in references,QC,features,tuning,labels. Any future concordance requires separate comparator namespace opened only after outputs are sealed; cannot establish biological accuracy.
